description: One module of an Arandu application: an entity, its fields, and who may do what to it. A deterministic generator turns this into Go -- the model never writes Go.

examples.description: An invoice issued to a customer.
examples.name: invoice

description.description: What this module is for, in a sentence. Not used for generation -- it is there so a person can approve the spec instead of the diff.

fields.description: The columns. id, tenant_id, created_at and updated_at are generated for every module -- do not declare them.

name.description: The column name, lowercase with underscores.

required.description: NOT NULL in the schema, and validated as present in the request.

type.description: The type of the column. bool is true or false; date is a day, with no time; decimal is fractional number -- never money; email is an address, validated as one; int is whole number; money is an amount, stored in cents as an integer; string is short text, up to a line; text is long text; timestamp is a moment; uuid is an identifier.

unique.description: A unique index, scoped by tenant when the module is.

name.description: The module name, lowercase with underscores: purchase_order, not PurchaseOrder.

additionalProperties.description: The roles allowed to take this action.

permissions.description: Which roles may take which action. The generated Policy denies everything not listed here -- an action with no entry is an action nobody can take.

tenant.description: Scope every query by the tenant of the Grant. True for anything that belongs to a customer, which is almost everything in a SaaS.

version.description: The schema version this document is written against.

title: Arandu module
